proposal.reason: Main change is a new built-in TROCE GIN backend (discovery, connect/context lifecycle, device API dispatch, SignalSet semantics, and GIN plugin wiring), which squarely falls under gin. Include network because the PR also makes substantive shared net_ib transport changes (provider detection, QP inline policy, proxy signal op handling, and verbs opcode support) that can affect broader network transport behavior beyond TROCE-specific files.
